extracted.intended_audience: users of the Trial Decision Search system (opposition searches) — patent practitioners, agents, examiners, and members of the public searching JPO trial/appeal decisions
extracted.subtask_description: User manual guidance for the Search Result List screen of the Trial Decision Search (Opposition) feature, describing display behavior, filtering options, column meanings, download/print/CSV actions, and limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tab hit count display and tab-opening behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: "XXXX shows the hit count. (Example: When the hit count is 60, \"60\" is displayed in the parentheses.) Selecting the \"Opposition (XXXX)\" tab opens the Search Result List screen for oppositions."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the hit count is 0 or more than 3,000, an error occurs and the Search Result List is not displayed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrow results by four law categories
rubrics_metrics.description: The search results are displayed as hit counts for each law category (Patents, Utility models, Designs, or Trademarks). Each hit count is displayed as a link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select a link for an item to narrow down the results of the Search Result List by the selected item. When a link for an item is selected, the hit count for the item is displayed without a link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrow results by appeal or trial decision year
rubrics_metrics.description: The search results are displayed as hit counts by appeal or trial decision year. Each hit count is displayed as a link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select a link to narrow results by year. If there are some dates such as partially fixed dates, the target narrowing-down will be each of them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrow results by conclusion of trial decision
rubrics_metrics.description: The search results are displayed as hit counts for each conclusion of trial decision. For the top three items, the hit count of each item is displayed as a link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select a link to narrow results by conclusion. For conclusion of trial decision codes that are displayed, refer to Conclusion of Trial Decision Code/Conclusion of Judgment Code List.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document display format selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Select either Text Display or PDF Display for the Document Display screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text Display shows document in text format; PDF Display shows document in PDF format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple PDF Download behavior and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Clicking the "Multiple PDF Download" button when box on the "No." column is marked opens an authentication screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow on-screen instructions to complete authentication. When authentication is successful, you can download multiple Japanese documents at one time. You can select up to 20 documents at once. PDF file will be downloaded in ZIP format as well if you select just one file. Trial decision bulletins are unavailable for this download. Publication displayed in "Opposition number" on the Search Result List will be downloaded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print List button
rubrics_metrics.description: Clicking the "Print List" button opens the Print List screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the Print List screen, a search result list can be printed.

rubrics_metrics.name: CSV Output requirements and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Clicking the "CSV Output" button opens the Authentication for CSV Output screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When application for the use of CSV output is acknowledged, a search result list can be output in CSV format. However, outputting in CSV format is possible only when there are 500 or fewer search results. If there are 501 or more search results, revise the search criteria so that only 500 or fewer results are returned. Application for the use of CSV output can be submitted in the Authentication for CSV Output screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search result list numbering (No.)
rubrics_metrics.description: The item number of each search result item is displayed as a series of numbers starting from 1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Four law categories column (in results)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the four law categories is displayed in the results list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kind (type of trial/appeal) column
rubrics_metrics.description: The type of the trial/appeal is displayed under the Kind column.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition number column and bulletin icon
rubrics_metrics.description: The opposition number is displayed. If a trial decision is partially fixed, the decision date of the partially-fixed trial decision is displayed under the opposition number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The opposition number and the decision date of the partially-fixed trial decision are displayed as links when relevant documents are available. Additionally, when the bulletin for the trial decision is available, the "Bulletin" icon is displayed on the right of the opposition number. Clicking a link opens the Document Display screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeal or trial decision date display rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The appeal or trial decision date is displayed. If there are some dates such as partially fixed dates, all of the appeal or trial decision dates will be shown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If there are some dates, it will be sorted with the newest date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification/Class column
rubrics_metrics.description: The classification or class is displayed in the Classification/Class column.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name/Trademark (for search) column and trademark reading
rubrics_metrics.description: The name or trademark for search is displayed. The trademark for search is a reading that is supplied so that a figure trademark can be searched for.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For some trademarks, the data for search is not stored. In this case, a hyphen (-) is displayed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opponent column display when multiple opponents
rubrics_metrics.description: The name of the opponent is displayed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When there is more than one opponent, only the name of one person is displayed and the names of the other persons are omitted and displayed as "Other".

rubrics_metrics.name: Right holder column display when multiple right holders
rubrics_metrics.description: The name of the right holder is displayed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When there is more than one right holder, only the name of the head person is displayed and the names of the other persons are omitted and displayed as "Other".

rubrics_metrics.name: Conclusion of trial decision column
rubrics_metrics.description: The conclusion of the trial decision is displayed in the Conclusion of trial decision column.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human translation button (Options)
rubrics_metrics.description: This button is displayed when the PDF of the human translation version of a document is available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clicking the "human translation" button displays the PDF of the human-translated document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Details button (Options)
rubrics_metrics.description: Clicking the "Details" button opens the Inquiry of history information screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Jump to Top of List button (Options)
rubrics_metrics.description: Clicking the "Jump to Top of List" button moves to the top of the search result list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other tabs (Ex parte, Inter partes, Judgment Gazette) and their hit-count limits
rubrics_metrics.description: "Ex parte trial/appeal (XXXX)", "Inter partes trial/appeal (XXXX)", and "Judgment Gazette (XXXX)" tabs show the hit count. Selecting each opens the corresponding Search Result List screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the hit count is 0 or more than 3,000, an error occurs and the Search Result List is not displayed (same limit rule as for the Opposition tab).
